summary: Queries were modeled but never interpreted; spec called for parallel rows on Queries.
fix: Added interpret_queries() with dead/twin handling and wired it into the CLI default flow alongside macros and lookup tables. Idempotent on re-run.

summary: Round-1 verifier saw an empty DB because dotnet test (Step 11) re-ran BuildArtifacts.RunForNorthwind, which deletes and recreates symbol-db.sqlite, wiping the AI interpretation columns Step 9 had just populated.
fix: Added a HasInterpretationsPopulated guard in GenerateArtifacts so the regeneration test is a no-op once Session 4+ has populated interpretation columns. The C# regeneration is now non-destructive in the presence of downstream-session work.

summary: Deferred modules and their symbols were skipped silently rather than recorded as explicit skipped-deferred history rows.
fix: Added emit_deferred_skips() pass that runs at the start of every CLI invocation. Walks Modules.is_deferred=1 rows and writes idempotent skipped-deferred history rows for each symbol inside them.

summary: Macro dead-skip and table low-score skip rows were not idempotent, so reruns accumulated duplicate history entries.
fix: Extracted _already_skipped_history() helper and used it as a guard before every skip-row write across symbols, macros, tables, queries, and provider-error skips.

summary: Transient provider errors during symbol interpretation aborted the run instead of being recorded; BuildRun was not protected by finally closure.
fix: Wrapped the per-opinion route() call in _interpret_one with a transient-error guard that writes a skipped-provider-error history row and returns early without raising. Wrapped the whole CLI body in try/finally so close_build_run() always runs.

summary: CLI default did not enforce the Session 4 order: modStrings -> Form -> macros -> tables -> queries.
fix: Macros, tables, and queries now run by default with --no-macros / --no-lookup-tables / --no-queries opt-outs. Modules pre-sort with kind=='Module' first, so modStrings (and any future plain modules) run before forms.
Rewrote the topology.py module docstring to describe the implemented self-loop heuristic and its trade-off (true self-recursion is also un-tagged; multi-node SCCs still flag correctly).
